description: This file defines a PHP class for compiling the {make_nocache} tag in Smarty templates. It includes methods for compiling PHP code that marks specific template variables as not cacheable.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Make_Nocache
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling the {make_nocache} Smarty template tag, handling attribute validation and code generation for non-cache parts of templates.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the {make_nocache} tag into PHP code that marks template variables as not cacheable if caching is enabled.
